name: VANTAGE: Autonomous Defence Intelligence
summary: A multi-agent AI framework for cybersecurity: specialised agents for vulnerability assessment, penetration testing and incident investigation, plus a RAG chatbot with chat and voice. JSI develops the multi-agent AI and chatbot and leads the pilots in CSIRT and SOC settings.

name: PERISCOPE: Participatory Engagement & Resilience Initiative against Strategic Communication and Propaganda in Europe
summary: Countering disinformation, gendered hate speech and foreign information manipulation through inclusive media literacy, civic engagement and responsible AI, including workshops on the ethics and responsible use of AI.

name: ViroiDoc: Advanced Research on Viroid Pathogenesis and Control for Agricultural Sustainability
summary: A doctoral network training ten researchers on viroids, the smallest infectious plant pathogens: how they cause disease, how climate change affects infection, and how to detect them and protect crops, combining molecular biology with bioinformatics.

name: EnviroViroSeq: Advanced HTS and AI-powered Analysis of Viromes in Hops and the Environment
summary: Mapping viromes in hops, weeds, wild hops and irrigation water to find pathogen reservoirs and see how irrigation spreads them. The project combines Nanopore high-throughput sequencing and CRISPR-based detection with AI-supported discovery of new viruses and visual analysis of virome overlap and phylogeny. Led by the Slovenian Institute of Hop Research and Brewing, with the Biotechnical Faculty (UL) and JSI.

name: TWON: Twin of Online Social Networks
summary: Digital twins of online social networks: LLM-driven agents simulate debates and information spread on social media, so platform designs can be tested before they reach real users.

name: AI4Gov: Trusted AI for Transparent Public Governance
summary: Trustworthy, explainable and unbiased AI for public administration: bias-detection pipelines, the Virtualized Unbiasing Framework and open courses on trustworthy and democratic AI.

name: NAIADES: Water ecosystem digitization
summary: AI for the urban water sector: anomaly detection, water-demand prediction and a water-intelligence observatory built from open data for evidence-based decisions.

name: Fusion pore regulation in insulin secretion
summary: Live-cell TIRF imaging of single insulin granules in pancreatic β-cells, showing how cAMP/Epac2 and PI(4,5)P2 regulate the exocytotic fusion pore and cargo release.

name: Exocytosis in astrocytes
summary: High-resolution membrane-capacitance measurements and STED microscopy of gliotransmitter vesicles, resolving single fusion events and fusion-pore states in astrocytes.
